text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After helping {0} capture the poachers, Muimi was rewarded with a boat by the fishermen so she could finally set sail.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}とともに密漁者を捕まえるのに
協力したムイミは、漁師たちの計らいもあって
海に出る船を用意してもらえることになっていた──

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: We're done helping those old guys! Now that you're with me, let's go all out and do this thing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっちゃんたちは助け終わった！
せっかくオマエが一緒なんだ。
ここから一気に行くぞ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Toh... I am borrowing you for a while here, so we'd better write a letter to Kokkoro and the others.
text_block_list.orig_text:
っと……
オマエを借りてくから、
コッコロたちに手紙書いとくか。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? You seem surprised. You're the one who told me to talk to someone from here, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだよ、
びっくりしてどうした？
近くの人に相談しろって言ったのは
オマエだぞ？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: So I'm asking the person who's right here to help me out. Let's go off together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから今近くにいるオマエに協力してもらって、
一緒に行くんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Across this sea. Didn't I tell you I was looking for a monster?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この海の向こうだよ。
魔物を探してるって言ったろ？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...We're going to hunt this monster back to where he lives, Elpis Island. Let me warn you, it's an incredibly dangerous one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ソイツがいるエルピス島で化け物退治だ。
それも、
とんでもなくヤバいヤツだよ。

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: We're ready to set sail! Get in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
船を出す準備ができたぞ！
乗ってくれ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Thanks, old man! ...Actually, I was planning to look for a few more comrades, but you never know when an opportunity like this will rise again, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとなおっちゃん！
……ホントはもう少し仲間を探すつもりだったけど、
こんなチャンス、
次にいつ来るか分からないだろ？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: So please... Come with me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから頼む……
アタシについてきてくれ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: That's great! You're a lifesaver! No... we'll be saving lives! Now that we're settled, on board! Let's head to Elpis Island!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすがだな！　
助かる！　
いや、
助けられる！
そうと決まれば乗った乗った！　
エルピス島に
出発だー！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Daaaaahhhh... Hhhuuurgggggh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だぁぁぁぁ～……
おええええ～……

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha ha! Are you guys alright? If you're feeling really seasick, lie down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっはっはっはっ！　
大丈夫かいあんたたち！
船酔いがキツいなら横になっときな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: W-We'll do just that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうさせてもらうぞ……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Aaah... Everything's wobbling...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～……
ぐらぐらずる～……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: W-What...? Ugh... My eyes are flickering...
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんだ……？　
うぅ～……
目がチカチカするぅ～……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Having finished her work that involved traveling all over the world, Muimi was visiting Japan for the first time in a while.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──世界各地を飛び回る仕事を終えた矛依未は、
久しぶりに日本を訪れていた。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Octo, are you there?! I brought you a souvenir!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オクトー
いるかー！　
土産持ってきたぞ！

text_block_list.name: Eito
text_block_list.text: I'm noooot... Or rather, could you stop calling me that? How's that mask meant to be a "souvenir"...? Where am I supposed to display it? You really have no taste for those things, Novem.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いませーん
っていうか、
その呼び方やめてくれないかなー？
土産って
何その仮面……。
どこに飾れっていうのさ。
ノウェムって
そういうとこセンスないよね。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Shut up! Isn't it cool?! Just accept it! More importantly, Octo! Let's play Astrum together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うるさい！　
かっこいいだろ！　
素直に受け取れ！
それよりオクトー！　
一緒にアストルムやるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Eito
text_block_list.text: Noooo waaaay. It's too much trouble. I'm busy checking documents I had an AI draft. Basically, I'm literally working overtime here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いー……
やーー
だね。
面倒くさいし。
AIに作らせた書類の確認で忙しいから。
僕ってば
今残業中なんだけど、
見て分からない？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: If you won't play, I'll burn your computer to a crisp.
text_block_list.orig_text:
遊ばないなら
オマエのパソコンを焼いてやる。

text_block_list.name: Eito
text_block_list.text: Aww. So you're the kind of girl who says nasty things like that, Novem. Quite the villain.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーあ。
そういうこと言っちゃうんだね
ノウェムって。
とんでもなく悪いヤツだ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Of course! I am a real nasty girl!
text_block_list.orig_text:
当たり前だ！　
アタシは悪いヤツだからな！

text_block_list.name: Eito
text_block_list.text: Just so you know... we're on school grounds, so be a little quieter. A bad girl like you will be mistaken for a suspicious person and get kicked by a teacher.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのさー、
校内だから
もう少し静かにしてよー
悪いヤツなノウェムは
不審者扱いされて、
先生につまみ出されるよ？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I'm cancelling out the echoes with my powers, so don't worry about it! Just log in already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
音の反響なら
アタシがかき消してるから気にするな！
いいからログインするぞ！

text_block_list.name: Eito
text_block_list.text: Using your powers in such a place so carefree... don't blame me if your head gets blown off out of nowhere. Good grief...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうとこで能力使うとか、
頭吹き飛ばされても知らないよ？
やれやれ……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Today Minerva's protecting me, so I can use them as much as I want! Also, you've already put your "mimi" on, so you obviously wanted to play too! Come on, let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はミネルヴァが守ってくれてるから使い放題だ！
そう言いながらすぐにmimiつけるってことは、
オマエも遊びたがってたんだろ？　
ほら行くぞ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi and Eito
text_block_list.text: "Dive Astrum"!
text_block_list.orig_text: ダイブ・アストルム！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: So? What are we going to do today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで？　
今日は何するの？

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Let me think...
text_block_list.orig_text: そうだなー……

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: If you're only deciding now, I'm logging out. See you~
text_block_list.orig_text:
今から決めるなら帰るよー。
お疲れー

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, wait, wait! There are so many things I want to do, so it's hard to choose!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待て待て待て待て！
やりたいことが多いから選ぶのが大変なんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Alright, I've decided! I'll go with a limited-time quest! Hmm, which one should I choose...? Huh? Hey, is that {0} over there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし決めた！　
限定クエストにしよう！
どれにしようかなー
っと……
あれ？
なあ、
あそこにいるのって{0}か？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Looks like it. He's not playing with his friends today? ...Novem? What are you doing? Don't tell me you're planning to call out to him?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうみたいだね。
仲間と遊んでたんじゃない？
……ノウェム？　
何してるの？　
もしかして
声かけるつもり？

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Yo, {0}! What are you doing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よっ{0}！　
何してるんだ？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Hello. Oh dear, he's all stiff. What are we going to do, Novem?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうもー。
あーあー、
彼ガチガチになってるよー
どうするのさノウェム。

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Don't ask me, you're putting me on the spot here! How have you been? We're fine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシに言われても困るぞ！　
元気にしてたか？
アタシは元気だぞ！

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Nope! Nothing of the sort today. We simply wanted to play in Astrum properly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
違うぞ！　
今日はそういうのナシな。
たまにはアタシらも
ちゃんとアストルムで遊びたいんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: I'm just here to keep Novem company. You see, we're always running errands for the Seven Crowns and getting sent to Astrum as part of our job.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクはノウェムの付き添いだよ。
ほら、
いっつも
七冠のパシリとして
仕事でアストルムやらされてるんだよね、
ボクらって。

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: That's right! So today we're just going to fool around! Don't be so alerted!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだぞ！　
だから今日はただ遊ぶだけだ！
だからそんなにビビるな！

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Meeting here is quite the bad luck for you! But since we did, let's go play together, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここで会ったのも運の尽きだ！
せっかくだし
オマエも一緒に遊ぼう！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Think of it less as bad luck and more as fate. Novem, once you start talking, you really can't stop, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これも運の尽きじゃなくて
何かの縁ってことで。
ノウェムは言い出したら止まらないよー？

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: That settles it! Hey, Octo! No mischief, okay? Got it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
決まりだな！　
おいオクトー！
悪さはナシだぞ！　
分かったか？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: That's my line. Come on, stop saying stupid things and accept the quest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクのセリフだからそれ。
ほら、
バカなこと言ってないで
クエスト受注しなよ。

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, "stupid", you idiot?! Let's see... This one's good. We're leaving!
text_block_list.orig_text:
バカとは何だバカとは！
えーっと……
これでよし。
出発するぞー！

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: We're here! Are you guys ready?
text_block_list.orig_text:
着いたー！　
オマエら
準備はいいか？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Ready, she says... I've no idea what we're even doing, so what do you think?
text_block_list.orig_text:
準備も何も、
何をすればいいか知らないよー？

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: We've got to find and defeat the rare monster that appear in this area first!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このエリアに出てくるレアモンスターを
一番最初に見つけ出して
討伐するんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Oh, the one that only appears once a day. Why did you pick up such a bothersome quest?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
一日に一体しか現れないヤツか。
なんでまたそんな面倒なクエストにしたのさー

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't it be better to choose one where we could cooperate? Look, there are plenty of other people here too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかくなら協力できるほうがいいだろ？
ほら見ろ、
他のヤツらもたくさんいるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Indeed... there are quite a lot of players. Is Astrum filled with people who have nothing better to do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに……
結構な数のプレイヤーがいるね。
アストルムやってるのって暇人が多いんだ？

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: You're the only one who doesn't seem to be having fun, Octo! Now then, where's that monster...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽しくなさそうなのはオマエだけだぞオクトー！
さてさてー、
どこにいるー？

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Hey, you guys! Stop idling around and go look for the target! After finding it we also have to defeat it, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいオマエら！　
ぼさっとしてないで探せー！
見つけるだけじゃなくて
倒さなきゃいけないんだぞー！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright. Let's go look for this thing, then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいはーい。
それじゃ、
ボクらも探すとしますか。

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: What do you think? Is it there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうだー？　
そっちにはいたかー？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Nope, not here. Hey, Novem...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いないねー。
あのさーノウェムー？

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうしたー？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: The two of us are tired, so we're taking a break.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクらは疲れたから
少し休憩するよー

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Already tired?! You're seriously out of shape! Sheesh... fine, leave it to me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう疲れたのか！？　
運動不足だな！
ったくしょうがないな。
アタシにまかせろ！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: We're in your hands... Don't you think Novem's just way too energetic? It's like watching someone entertain their little niece at a family reunion.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よろしくー
……ノウェムが無駄に元気すぎるだけだと思わない？
親戚の集まりで
姪っ子の相手してあげてるみたいでしょ。

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I'm exhausted... Hmm... A peaceful world really is the best, isn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー疲れたー
……うーん、
やっぱり
世の中平和が一番だよねー

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Well, of course I'd say that~ Though you and I probably have very different ideas of what "peace" means.
text_block_list.orig_text:
言うに決まってるよー
キミとボクじゃ
認識の違いってのはあるだろうけどね。

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: I think everyone has their own idea of what peace looks like. Novem and I just happen to approach it from a fundamentally villainous perspective.
text_block_list.orig_text:
平和の形は
人それぞれって話じゃないかな。
ボクとノウェムは
根本の考え方が悪だから。

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Even so, we're still aiming for peace in our own villainous way. Oh, you don't have to believe me. If anything, you should be suspicious. A healthy dose of skepticism is important. Especially for a softie like you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これでも
悪なりの平和を目指してるんだ。
ああ、
別に信じなくていいよ。
むしろ疑ってていいから。
疑うことは大事さ。
キミみたいなお人よしくんは特にね。

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Actually, you see... What if I told you our constant PKing (Player Killing) as the "Eternal Society" was really just like pruning a bonsai tree... all so that only the strongest players would remain?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……実はさ。
ボクらが
【エターナル・ソサエティ】として
PKを繰り返していたのが、
実は
盆栽の剪定と同じ行為で、
有能なプレイヤーだけを残そうとしていたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Right. To keep only cooperative players like you around who can help their teammates and even strangers...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、
キミみたいに
仲間や見ず知らずの人を助けられて、
協調性のあるプレイヤーだけを残すためにね……

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Now then, if I said that... would you believe me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なーんて言ったら、
キミは信じる？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: That's a pretty wishy-washy answer. But that's okay. Because every word I just said was a lie.
text_block_list.orig_text:
中途半端な答えだねー。
でもそれでいいんだ。
なにせ今言ったのは、
全部ウソだから。

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: ...Oops! Are you mad? But isn't what you're doing actually not all that different from what we're doing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれれー？　
もしかして怒ったー？
でもさあ、
キミの行いだって
ボクらのやってることと、
実はそんなに違わない気がしない？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: In the first place, what you and Akira are doing for that AI... for Minerva, is that really human will? What's the difference between you and the witch from a fairy tale who blindly believes her magic mirror?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だいたい
キミや晶がAI……
ミネルヴァのためにやってることは、
果たしてヒトの意志なのかな？　
魔法の鏡の言葉を
真に受ける童話の魔女とキミらは、
どこが違うんだろうね？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, then you're a major villain who's siding with humans instigated by such an AI and rebelling against the world itself. Wow! Now that's cool. I almost admire you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だとしたらキミは、
そんなAIにそそのかされた人間に与して、
世界に反旗を翻す大悪党だ。
いやー
カッコいいね。
尊敬するよ。

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I've been rambling on like I know everything... but don't you ever get tired of thinking about this sort of thing? Personally, I find it exhausting all the time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……とまあ、
ここまでアレコレ偉そうにしゃべったけど、
こういうことを考えるの自体が
面倒くさくなる時もあるでしょ？
ボクにはいつだって面倒くさいんだけどねー

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: And right now happens to be one of those times for Novem. So if you keep bristling at us like that... you're going to ruin the little break she's finally getting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのタイミングが
ノウェムにとっては今なのさ。
だからキミにいちいちそうやってトゲトゲしくいられると、
せっかくの休息が台無しになるんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Or are you perhaps the kind of person who'd bomb a church because the enemy happened to be praying there unarmed during a war?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それともキミはあれかなー？
戦争中の相手が
武器を取らずに教会で礼拝しているのを、
敵を叩くチャンスだと思って爆撃しちゃうような人なの？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: You're not, right? That's good then. No matter what kind of tragic things may be happening in our reality, at least for now, we have this rule here that "Astrum is a game".
text_block_list.orig_text:
違うよね？　
ならよかった。
どんなにあっちの世界で悲惨なことが起きてても、
少なくとも今のところ
『アストルムはゲーム』
ってルールがある。

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: As long as that rule still holds, I think days like today are perfectly fine every now and then. ...Being enemies until one of us dies is incredibly tiring, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
このルールが有効なうちは、
今日みたいなことも
たまにはあっていいと思うんだ。
……どっちかが死ぬまで敵でいるなんて、
すっごく疲れるよ？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: It still feels weird being able to trust your enemy, doesn't it? That's fine, this is only temporary. Yaaay~ Good for us. Starting tomorrow, we're enemies again♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり
敵から信頼されてるのは変な気分かな？
大丈夫だって、
今だけだからさ。
わーやったねー。
明日からは敵同士だー

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, my condolences♪ We feel the same way. But if you've got complaints, take them up with the grown-ups who can't seem to get along, not us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あははー、
ご愁傷さまー♪　
それはボクらも同じさ。
でも文句はボクらじゃなくて、
仲良くできない大人たち宛でよろしくねー

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Hey! What are you two talking about?! I found our rare monster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーい！　
何仲良くしゃべってるんだオマエらー！
見つけたぞ、
レアモンスター！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Well now, it seems our dear Lady Novem is making a fuss. It's a pain, but shall we go?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
我らがノウェムさまが騒いでるね。
面倒だけど
行ってみますかー

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: HURRY UP AND COME! If you don't, the others will find it--...
text_block_list.orig_text:
早くこーい！　
じゃないと他のヤツらに見つかって──

text_block_list.name: Male Player 1
text_block_list.text: ...We've cornered them! Set them up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──追い込んだぞ！　
仕掛けろ！

text_block_list.name: Male Player 2
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! URAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まかせとけ！　
おらぁ！

text_block_list.name: Female Player 1
text_block_list.text: UWAAAAAHHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃああ
あっ！！

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Hm...? What's with these guys? Are they having a falling out?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……？　
なんだアイツら。
仲間割れか？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: I don't think so. It was a surprise attack from behind, so it's more likely those are PKers.
text_block_list.orig_text:
違うんじゃないかなー。
後ろからの不意打ちだったし、
可能性高いのは
PKだろうねー

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: PK?! But the person who was attacked wasn't killed, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
PK！？　
でも攻撃された方はやられてないぞ？

text_block_list.name: Male Player 2
text_block_list.text: Stand, you bitch! Get up already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おら立て！　
さっさとしろ！

text_block_list.name: Female Player 1
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuu...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うう
ぅ……

text_block_list.name: Female Player 2
text_block_list.text: What are you doing?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 何するんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Male Player 1
text_block_list.text: If you want this girl released, hand over ALL your money and items! All of them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
コイツを解放してほしけりゃ、
持ってる金とアイテムを全部寄こせ！　
全部だ！

text_block_list.name: Female Player 2
text_block_list.text: ...O-Okay. I'll give you everything. So let her go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……わ、
わかった。
全部渡す。
だからその子は放して！

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, if she does that, she'll be playing right into their hands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい、
そんなことしたら相手の思うツボだぞ。

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess so. We'd also strip them of everything and then PK them. Quite the evil mind, Novem.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだねー。
身ぐるみ剥がした挙句に
PKしちゃうよー
ノウェムも悪だねえ。

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Don't praise me! This is the belittler's area!
text_block_list.orig_text:
褒めるなって！　
これくらい序盤の入り口だ！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: You wanted to say it's the beginner's area, didn't you? I get it. Yeah, yeah.
text_block_list.orig_text:
序の口って言いたかったんだねー
分かるよー
うんうん。

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: S-Shut up! This place seems to be their hunting ground, and they're probably using the monsters as bait to lure players in without letting them get to kill them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うるさいっ！　
ここはアイツらの狩場になってて、
モンスターを倒させないでプレイヤーを誘い込むための
餌にしてるんだろうな。

text_block_list.name: Male Player 2
text_block_list.text: Hey! What have you guys been chattering about this whole time?! Are you guys friends with these guys?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいっ！　
さっきから何くっちゃべってんだお前らは！
こいつらの仲間か？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: No matter how you look at it, we're clearly unrelated. Oh, we'll take out that monster, so you can do whatever you want with them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう見ても他人でしょー。
ああ、
モンスターはボクらが
倒しておくから
そっちは好きにしてくれていいよー

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: This level of mischief doesn't warrant our involvement... Fighting that monster would be more fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この程度の悪さなら、
アタシらが戦うまでもないしな……
それより
モンスターと戦う方が面白そうだ！

text_block_list.name: Male Player 1
text_block_list.text: What...? Hey! We'll take care of those guys too! Call the others!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだと……？　
おい！
アイツらもやっちまうぞ！　
他のヤツらも呼べ！

text_block_list.name: Male Player 2
text_block_list.text: Sure! You heard him, guys... GET READY TO DIE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう！　
いいかお前ら、
覚悟しやがれぇ！

text_block_list.name: Female Player 1
text_block_list.text: P-Please help us!! Please!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
た、
助けてくださいっ！！　
お願いです！！

text_block_list.name: Female Player 2
text_block_list.text: At this rate, we won't be able to continue playing in Astrum...! That's the one thing I don't want to happen! So please...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このままじゃ私たち、
アストルムが続けられなくなっちゃう……！
それだけは嫌なんです！　
だから……！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Okay, stoooooop! That's enough!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいストーップ！　
そこまでー！

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Stop it, {0}. You can't fight all of these people alone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やめとけ{0}。
オマエ一人で戦える相手じゃないぞ。

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Right, right. Novem gets it. You don't want to fight alongside us, do you? Teaming up with us against other people isn't really your thing, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう。
ノウェムの言う通りだって。
キミ、
ボクらと一緒には戦いたくないでしょ？
人間相手に共闘は無理だよねー

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, {0}. Surely it's okay if we take care of those guys, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なあ{0}。
さすがにアイツらは、
アタシらがやっちゃってもいいよな？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Those scumbags will cause trouble if you leave them unchecked, you know? If you leave it to us, we'll take care of them completely. In the meanwhile, you can rescue those girls.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああいうクズな連中、
野放しにしておくと面倒くさいよ？
ボクらにまかせてくれたら、
キレイさっぱり片付けるけど？
キミにはキミで、
あの子たちを助けてもらいたいし。

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: I knew he'd say that, Octo! We'll take them on ourselves!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうくると思ったぞ！　
オクトー！
アイツらはアタシらで相手するぞ！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: What a pain... I know! Can you delete my account too while you're at it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
面倒くさいなぁ……
そうだ。
アカウントも消しちゃっていい？

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: We'll cooperate with {0}, so that's off this time! Instead, make sure you hurt those guys slowly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}と協力するから
今回はナシだ！
その代わり
じっくり痛めつけてやれ！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Understood. I hope it'll at least serve as a warm-up. Here we go! Go for it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
了解ー。
準備運動くらいにはなってもらいたいなー
そーれっ！　
行ってこーい！

text_block_list.name: Male Player 1
text_block_list.text: What's with this guy?! He's controlling monsters?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだコイツは！？
モンスターを操ってるだと！？

text_block_list.name: Male Player 2
text_block_list.text: I've never heard of a job that can do that!! W-WAAAAAAAAAH!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな真似できるジョブなんて聞いたことないぞ！！
う、
うわあああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: That's not fair, Octo! Let me have a share of the fun too! ORYAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ズルいぞオクトー！　
アタシにもおいしいとことっとけよな！
うおおおおりゃああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Male Player 1
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAAAAH! Who the hell are those two?! At this rate, we'll be done for!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぎゃあ
ああっ！
な、
なにやってんだアイツらは！
このままじゃこっちがやられちまうぞ！

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Heheh! In that case, be a good boy and be done for! DEEEEEEEEI!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へへっ！　
だったら大人しくやられとけ！
でえええええいっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Male Player 1
text_block_list.text: EEEEEEEEEK!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ひぃぃぃぃっ！！！！

text_block_list.name: Male Player 3
text_block_list.text: These players are our prey! Hey you bastard! Charge in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイツらが獲物か！　
おいお前ら！　
行くぞ！

text_block_list.name: Male Player 4
text_block_list.text: HYAAHAAAAAAAAAH!!! YOU'RE DONE FOR!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃっはあああっ！　
ぶっ殺してやらぁ！！

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Here comes some more, Octo! I'll let you take half! TEEEEEEEIYAH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きたきた！　
オクトー！
半分譲ってやる！　
でやああああっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: There are so many! Oh well. It's not like I'm the one who's going to defeat them. There you go... your next target!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
多いってばー。
まあいっか。
ボクが倒すわけじゃないし。
ほーら、
次の獲物だぞー

text_block_list.name: Men
text_block_list.text: GUAAAAHHHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐあああああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Phew... I guess that's enough for now. How about that, you've been beaten! Hope this teaches you a lesson and you don't do anything bad again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
これくらいにしといてやるか。
どうだ
参ったか！　
これに懲りたらもう悪さするなよ！

text_block_list.name: Men
text_block_list.text: WE'RE SO SORRYYYYYYY!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: すみませんでしたぁぁぁ～！！！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Wow, that was fast.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーわ、
すっごい早さ。

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Oh, {0}! They shouldn't be causing any more trouble, see?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
{0}！
もうアイツらは悪さしないはずだぞ？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Did we perhaps... overdid it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひょっとしてボクら……
やり過ぎちゃった？

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, "overdid it"?! Don't tell me you're put off too!? What were we supposed to do? They came at us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もってなんだもって！　
オマエも引いてるのか！？
しょうがないだろ、
アイツらが向かってきたんだ！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Now, now. At least we'll be able to return to looking for that monster safely, so it's fine even if we got the cold shoulder. You should actually be proud of it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあまあ。
無事にモンスター探しに戻れるわけだし、
いいじゃん引かれても。
むしろ誇っていいよ。

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We're true villains, after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だな！　
アタシらは悪いヤツだしな！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Ah, never mind that. We just happened to be in the same area, and we just happened to pass each other at the same time and place. Right, Novem?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーそういうのいいから。
ボクらは偶然同じエリアにいて、
偶然同じ時間に偶然同じ場所ですれ違っただけだし。
そうだよねーノウェム？

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...I don't really understand, but yeah! So don't worry about it! Let's go find the monster we lost sight of because of those guys! Follow me! Wooooooooah!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？　
……よく分からんがそうだ！　
だから気にするな！
それよりアイツらのせいで見失ったモンスターを探すぞ！
アタシについてこい！　
うおおおおおっ！！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Uwah, here it is... her annoyingly loud voice... I hope things don't get any more troublesome after this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわー出たー、
暑苦しい大声だー
この後も面倒くさいことになりませんようにー……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Novem and Octo, working with {0}, found the monster, successfully defeated it, and returned to Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その後、{0}と協力して
モンスターを見つけたノウェムとオクトーは討伐に成功し、
ランドソルへと帰還した。

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: The reward really wasn't much to write home about...
text_block_list.orig_text:
報酬、
あんまりパッとしなかったな……

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: It was geared towards beginners, after all. For people like us who have been playing for a while, getting it wouldn't be much of a benefit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
初心者向けだったねー。
ボクらくらいやってると
貰ってもあんまり恩恵はないかなー

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Well, whatever! More importantly, I had a great time playing with you today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあいい！　
それより今日は、
一緒に遊べて楽しかったぞ！

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Next time we meet, it'll be as enemies! See you around!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度会う時は敵同士だな！　
またなー！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Bye bye. Say hi to Akira for me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ばいばーい。
晶によろしくー

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Why? ...Well?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしてって……
なあ？

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Yeah...?
text_block_list.orig_text: ねえ……？

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: You're our enemy, but you're our... um, what do you call someone you want to root for in Japanese? Anyway, that's the word I'm going for here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オマエは敵だけど、
アタシらの……
えーっと、
日本語で応援したいヤツのことなんて言うんだ？
とにかくそれなんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Octo
text_block_list.text: Speaking on behalf of the simple-minded Novem, you're one of our favorites (oshi)... one of the people we're rooting for. So take care of yourself, stay healthy, and do your best. See you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
単細胞なノウェムに代わって言うと、
キミはボクら二人と……
あとその他の『推し』なのさ。
というわけで、
今後も健康には気をつけながら、
せいぜい頑張って。
じゃあねー

text_block_list.name: Noemu
text_block_list.text: Octo!! That guy!! I'm gonna punch him in the face back in reality! See ya! Bye!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オクトー！！　
アイツぅ～！！
リアルで一発ぶっ飛ばす！　
じゃあなー！　
またなー！

text_block_list.name: Eito
text_block_list.text: Novem, wanna grab something to eat before we head home?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ノウェムー。
なんか食べて帰るー？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Your treat?! Sounds good to me! Let's hit that place by the station, yeah?
text_block_list.orig_text:
オマエのおごりか！？　
いいなそれ！
店は駅前でいいよな？

text_block_list.name: Eito
text_block_list.text: You're obviously the one making more money than me, and I'm paying? I'll kick your ass, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう考えてもノウェムのほうが稼いでるのに
ボクのおごり？
ぶっ飛ばすよ？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: That's my line! Be grateful I didn't beat you up just now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちのセリフだ！
さっきぶっ飛ばさなかっただけありがたく思え！

text_block_list.name: Eito
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, of course. How very kind of you, Great Villain Lady Novem.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーそうですねー。
お優しいですねー
大悪党ノウェムさまはー

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Right, keep it up! Praise me even more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだろそうだろー！　
もっと褒めていいぞ！

text_block_list.name: Eito
text_block_list.text: No, I'm already full, so it's fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
もうお腹いっぱいだからいいよ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: You're full? Then you're not eating anything when we get to the restaurant!
text_block_list.orig_text:
腹いっぱいなのか？　
じゃあオマエは店に行っても何も食うな！

text_block_list.name: Eito
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh...? That was a figure of speech, you know? You ignored that on purpose, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええー……
今のは例えなんですけどー？
敢えてだよね？　
敢えて無視してるよね？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: No! Stop! Let me go!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやっ！　
やめて！　
放して！！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Come on now! What's the big deal? You're free, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えええ～？　
んだよいいじゃんかー！　
暇してんだろー？

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: You must be free! Just a little! Right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
暇してんだろー？　
ちょっとだけだからさ！　
ね～？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: I'm not! SOMEONE! HELP ME!
text_block_list.orig_text:
違います！　
誰かぁ！　
助けてください！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Ah! U-Um, thank you very much...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
あ、
あの、
ありがとうございます……！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: What's this? Get outta the way, brat! We're busy here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんだぁ？　
どけガキ！　
こっちぁ忙しいんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: Don't get in the way, 'kay? You'll get hurt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
邪魔すんなって、
な？　
怪我すんぞ？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So that's what's going on. Octo, I'll leave {0} and the lady to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……読めたぞ。
そういうことか。
オクトー、
{0}たちはまかせる。

text_block_list.name: Eito
text_block_list.text: Ehh... I have no idea what you're talking about, but sure. Just don't overdo it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー……
どういうことか分かんないけど、
とりあえず了解。
ほどほどにしときなよー

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Yo! What are you doing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よっ！　
なにやってんだ？

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: Another pipsqueak appeared... THE HELL D'YA WANT?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
またなんか出てきたぞ……
なんなんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Leave this to me. Get out of here. You'll just get in my way if you stay nearby.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここはアタシにまかせろ。
さっさと行け。
近くにいられたらアタシが困るからな。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: B-But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
でも……

text_block_list.name: Eito
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. That girl'll be fine. Okaaay, come over!
text_block_list.orig_text:
心配しないで。
あの子なら大丈夫だから、
はーいこっちこっちー

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I said to not worry! But thanks! Bad guys really are everywhere!
text_block_list.orig_text:
心配するな！　
でもありがとな！
悪いヤツってのはどこにでもいるもんだ！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: ...So? Are you for real? Hey, hey. If you move from there, we'll forgive you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……で？　
なんなのマジで？
なぁおい。
今すぐそこどいたら許してやるよ。

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: If you don't, hell awaits, ya bastard! D'YA UNDERSTAND?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さもないと地獄見るぞお前！　
分かってんのか！？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Hell, huh... Hey, have you ever seen hell?
text_block_list.orig_text:
地獄か……
なあ、
地獄って見たことあるか？

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: As if, idiot. But we're sending ya there right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あるかボケ。
今からお前が見るんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Figured as much... You've never slept in a manhole, fought over scraps in a pile of garbage, or tasted the water of a river littered with corpses.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよな……
マンホールの中で寝泊まりもしてないし、
ゴミの山で食べ物のためにケンカもしてなけりゃ、
死体の転がる川の味も知らないよな。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you saying...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ？　
何言ってんだ……？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: It means hell exists everywhere in this world, you scum. To that woman, this road became hell tonight. Because of you. People like you are the ones who create hell.
text_block_list.orig_text:
地獄はこの世界のどこにでもあるってことだよ。
クズども。
さっきの女にとっては
今日この夜、
この道が地獄になった。
オマエらだ。
オマエらみたいなのが
地獄を生み出すんだ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I'll never forgive anyone who creates hell in this world. It's because of people like you that the world will never know peace. You hurt the powerless without a second thought... and you've never even known pain yourselves.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシは世界に地獄を生み出すヤツを
絶対に許さない。
オマエらみたいなのがいるから、
世界は平和にならない。
力のない人を平気で傷つけて、
痛みを知りもしない……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Good for you. I'm about to show you what hell really looks like. You've shown hell to other people. You're ready to see it yourselves... aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかったなオマエら。
今からアタシが、
オマエらにちゃんと地獄を見せてやるよ。
人に地獄を見せたんだ。
自分も見る覚悟はできてるよな？

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: H-Hey... There's electricity all around her...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おい……
なんか、
こいつの周りに電気が……

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Don't freak out! She's probably carrying some kind of stun gun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ビビんな！　
どうせスタンガンでも持ってるだけだろ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Hey. Do you know what works best on scum who create hell...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なあ、
地獄を生み出す悪いヤツに
一番効果があるものを知ってるか……？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: That is... fear. I shall carve it into your very souls. Fear of hell...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そいつはな……
恐怖ってヤツだ。
オマエらの魂に
じっくりと刻んでやるよ。
地獄の恐怖をな……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: ...What was that just now... I see... so that's how she applies it to cognitive interference and the world's correction...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……何なのよ、
今の……
そっか、
あれが認識阻害や世界の修正に応用されて……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: If anyone deserves a "good job" this time, it's me... Thanks to the bond you've built with her, I've finally been able to access a small part of her memories...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今回お疲れさまって言ってほしいのはあたしのほうよ……
あんたと絆が深まってきたおかげで、
ようやく少しだけ記憶にアクセスできるようになったけど……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: You don't need to see what comes next. It's... pretty horrifying. Because her memories are protected by her powers, they're far too vivid...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここから先はあんたは見なくていいわ。
かなりえげつないもの……
能力で保護してる分
この子の記憶は鮮明すぎるわ……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: It's far too gruesome for you to witness right now. Their lives weren't in any danger... if anything, that almost makes it worse.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今のあんたには見せられないくらいエグいのよ。
相手の命に別状はないんだけどね。
それが余計にたちが悪いっていうか……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: I'm just glad Novem isn't the kind of person who preys on... good people. Even so, she's still walking a dangerous line. One wrong trigger could send her down a very different path...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ノウェムが人を……
善人を虐げる側の存在じゃなくて
よかったわ。
それでも
まだ何かのきっかけで
違う方へ転んじゃうかもしれない危うさはあるけど……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: I think the reason she never became twisted despite wielding so much power is because she understands what it's like for people who have none. More than anyone, she's sensitive to how power should be used.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれだけの力を持ってるのに
歪まずにいられたのは、
力を持たない人たちの辛さを理解していたからだと思うわ。
そうでなくても、
力というものの扱いにとても敏感なのよ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Octo is her partner, but at the same time, he might be protecting her. To prevent her from becoming someone's tool or weapon... that's only possible because their goals for life align.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オクトーは相棒だけど、
同時にあの子を保護してるのかも。
誰かの道具や凶器にならないように……
それは目指す生き方が
一致したからこそできてるんでしょうね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Those two still need someone watching over them. Octo's always drifting wherever the wind takes him, so keeping an eye on him won't be easy... but make sure you watch over Novem, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人ともまだまだ注意しておかないといけないわよ。
オクトーはフラフラしてるから目を配るのは難しいでしょうけど、
相棒ともども、
ノウェムをちゃんと見ておいてあげなさい。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: That's what you... the one who's their "favorite," can do for those two right now. I'm sure you shine very brightly to them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが今のあんたの……
『推し』のあんたが
あの子たちにしてあげられることよ。
……あんたのことはきっと、
すごく眩しく映ってるんでしょうね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: See you later, then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
またね。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Nn... nnnnn...! Ahhh...I slept well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……
んんーっ……！
あーっ……
よく寝たー……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're awake too? Good morning! I don't know what time it is!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ、
オマエも起きたのか？
おはよう！　
何時なのかは
分からん！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I feel like I had a really nostalgic dream... but I can't quite remember it... Hmm...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだかすごく懐かしい夢を見てた気がする……
でもハッキリ思い出せないんだ……
う～ん……！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Well, whatever! But seriously, the ocean is amazing! I never thought I'd be able to see such a beautiful view!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあいいや！　
それにしても
海ってすごいな！
こんなにいい景色が拝めるなんて思ってなかったぞ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong? Is something bothering you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
どうした？　
なんか気になるのか？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: That was sudden. Of course not. As for Octo... I don't know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いきなりだな。
あるわけないだろ。
オクトーは……
知らん！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Octo and I both want to do bad things. But we only want to do them against bad guys.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシもオクトーも悪いことはしたい。
でも
相手は悪いヤツだけだ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Doing bad things to good people doesn't make us feel any fun or satisfaction.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいヤツに悪いことしても、
面白くも気持ちよくもならないんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Only bad and weak people do bad things to good people. You're a good person, so it's impossible for you to become my enemy! And when we fought before, it was all just a pretense!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいヤツに悪いことをするのはな、
悪くて弱いヤツだけだ。
オマエはいいヤツなんだから、
敵になるのはもう無理だぞ！
前に戦ってた時も
実はフリだったしな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: You've helped me out again, so if there's anything you need my help with, just tell me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オマエにはまた助けてもらったし、
アタシに助けてほしいことがあれば言ってくれ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I look forward to our continued future as allies, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからも味方として、
よろしくな！
{0}！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Seeing Muimi's smiling face as she said that, {0} felt like he understood her a little better than before.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──そう言って笑いかけるムイミの笑顔を見た
{0}は、今までよりも少しだけ
彼女のことを理解できたような気がしたのだった。
